`unlockSound` only hides an overlay, no preventDefault — harmless. My explicit Enter handler is now in place. 

One more possible real cause: `unlockSound` runs in **capture phase on window**, and if the overlay `#sound` sits **on top of the form**, the first click/Enter goes to the overlay, not the input. That would make typing impossible though—but you said you *can* type. So the overlay isn't blocking.

Now rebuild the web on xx01 and verify Enter works via headless (including the new button)
